notes.title: Alienware FX now supported in patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Latest patch now contains support for Alienware FX! (only available to those with an Alienware machine) 
Features include:
- Pulsing on punches
- Partying in slowmo
- Dimming on death

We've also addressed some Japanese translation errors.

Thanks to everyone for their continued support and please keep the suggestions coming <3
- Team Shifty

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25336981/8502337405e286a6a0b02ca30d71a2e909a5d0c4.png[/img]
Hey everyone!

A great big thank you to everyone who has supported us and enjoyed Mr. Shifty.
We've been listening closely to your feedback, and the latest patch as the following improvements:

[h1] Update 1.0.4 [/h1] 
[list]
    [*]Difficulty balancing - Toned down some of the more frustrating levels.
    [*]Japanese now supported
    [*]Stage Restart option now in pause menu
    [*]Reduced load times
    [*]Added support for various controller types previously not working
    [*]Improved game performance
    [*]Doors now fly further
    [*]Various level bugs fixed
    [*]Enemies should be a little bit more "human"
[/list] 

We have a big list of exciting changes we'd like to add to the game, and take your suggestions and feedback very seriously. Please let us know what you think of the game, and any suggestions in the forums!

Thanks,
Team Shifty

notes.title: Mr. Shifty is launching on April 13th
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/BHfgmxJ.gif[/img]

[h1]Launching Next Thursday[/h1]

Good news everyone! 

We're ready to launch Mr. Shifty next week, Thursday April 13th! 

Book the date.

[h1]Latest trailer[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GMHXflP-Vf0

Yes, it is also coming to Switch if you're wondering. 

[h1]Open Beta Still Live![/h1]

The open beta is still live and serves as a demo of what to expect. The game's been polished up really nicely since then, but if you still want to get an idea of how Mr. Shifty plays, go ahead and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=http://eepurl.com/b4GuOP]download the beta here. [/url]

[h1]Don't forget to Wishlist on Steam![/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/489140
